metrics.name: Trial to Paid Conversion
metrics.description_hint: % of trial users who convert to paid.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS trial_to_paid_conversion_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Feature Activation Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users who triggered the core activation event.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS feature_activation_rate_pct FROM {table}
